প্রজ্ঞাপন

তারিখ : ১৭ আষাঢ়, ১৪২০ বঙ্গাব্দ/১ জুলাই, ২০১৩ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

Ministry of Finance: This is the government ministry responsible for the issuance of the statutory notification.
Internal Resources Division: This is the administrative department under the Ministry of Finance that issued the notification concerning customs and value added tax matters.
Customs: The subject of this notification pertains to regulatory oversight and administration within the customs domain.
Value Added Tax: The subject of this notification pertains to regulatory oversight and administration within the value added tax domain.

Customs Act 1969: This act provides the legal authority for the government to issue notifications for tax exemptions and modifications under section 19(1).
Value Added Tax Act 1991: This act provides the legal authority for the government to issue notifications regarding tax modifications under section 14(1).
National Board of Revenue: The government is required to consult with the National Board of Revenue before exercising its powers to amend customs or tax notifications.
S.R.O. 157-AIN/2012: This existing notification is being amended to include additional H.S. Code entries within its associated tariff table.
Bangladesh Customs Tariff: The tariff table is updated by inserting new Heading Numbers and H.S. Codes for specific goods to adjust the scope of the original notification.
